summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Lloyds Banking Group plc on 12 June 2026, reporting routine director/PDMR share transactions under the company's Share Incentive Plan (SIP). It discloses acquisitions of Partnership Shares and Matching Shares by several PDMRs, including Chirantan Barua, Kate Cheetham, Sharon Doherty, and Stephen Shelley, executed on 9 June 2026. The share price for Partnership Shares was GBP 0.9906 per share, with Matching Shares awarded at nil cost. These are ordinary-course compensatory equity grants, not a special situation. There is no M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event.
